title: tc-logo-marquee
description: The endless "Trusted by" strip: rows of logos that loop, ease to a stop on hover, scrub with inertia and pause for good.

speed.description: Pixels per second, independent of the strip's width

direction.description: Which way the first row runs; a second row runs the other way

rows.description: 1, or 2 for a second row in the opposite direction (the logos are split between the rows)

gap.description: Space between logos in px (smaller on narrow containers)

pauseOnHover.description: Ease to a stop while the pointer is over the strip or it has keyboard focus

paused.description: Stopped for good (the Pause / Play button's state)

pauseButton.description: Show the Pause / Play button (on by default – moving content needs a way to stop it, WCAG 2.2.2)

grayscale.description: Muted, colourless logos that lift to full colour on hover

labels.description: Show the brand name under each mark or beside it, like a wordmark

buttonLabels.description: The Pause button's name, and the Play button's

name.description: Brand name – the accessible name, and the visible label when `labels` is on

src.description: An image instead of `svg` (shown grayscale until hovered when `grayscale` is on)

color.description: Brand colour the mark lifts to on hover, e.g. "#635BFF" – leave out for black marks

scale.description: Optical size correction, e.g. 0.9 for a heavy round mark – 1 by default

href.description: Turns the logo into a link
